description: AMP – MOVIMIENTO DE VEHÍCULO POR PUERTO is a series of datasets listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Maritima de Panamá. Presenta el movimiento de vehículo en el sistema portuario nacional en unidades. Coverage: Panamá. The portal lists 23 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Autoridad Maritima de Panamá. Its tags are Logistica, Maritimo, Puerto, Vehiculo. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2019-08-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
